description: This source file contains unit tests for the ScreenController class in an iOS application. It verifies various behaviors such as web view configuration, navigation, JavaScript evaluation, URL trustworthiness, and JSON parsing within the ScreenController context.

classes.name: ScreenControllerTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the ScreenController class in the iOS app.

methods.name: mountScreen
methods.description: Helper function to set up a ScreenController instance with its WebView and Coordinator, used across multiple tests.

methods.name: canvasModeConfiguresWebViewForTouch
methods.description: Test to ensure the WebView is properly configured for touch interactions in canvas mode.

methods.name: navigateEnablesScrollForWebPages
methods.description: Test that navigation to a URL enables scrolling in the WebView.

methods.name: navigateSlashShowsDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Test that navigating to '/' results in an empty URL string, indicating default view.

methods.name: evalExecutesJavaScript
methods.description: Test to verify executing JavaScript asynchronously within the WebView returns expected results.

methods.name: trustedRemoteA2UIURLMustMatchExactly
methods.description: Test to verify trust URL matches exactly, including fragment considerations, for security.

methods.name: genericNavigationClearsTrustedRemoteA2UIURL
methods.description: Test to ensure that navigation to a different URL clears previously trusted URLs.

methods.description: Test for parsing JSON string bodies into dictionary representations.
